note: The definition for re-making the example's ending video. The seats (at, dur) are on the beats of the song, and are best left where they are. Seats 1-26 are cut from the finished videos/ending.mp4 at each seat's second. Replace only the seats you want with your own photos or videos (--replace); the others stay as in the example. A build makes videos/my_ending.mp4 (ending.mp4 is the template and is never overwritten). To play it in the show, change the [Video] on picture 5 of the script to videos/my_ending.mp4
audio_note: Mozart, The Marriage of Figaro overture, played by the Musopen Symphony; the recording was released into the public domain by Musopen (the Musopen Kickstarter Project on Wikimedia Commons). The whole overture is about 4 minutes, so it is cut: 0-107.46 s of the original (part-way into the exposition, cut on a loud chord) and 202.61 s to the end (the coda), joined with a 0.06 s cross-fade, with 3 s of silence added (148.79 s). The join is at 107.40 s, between seats 19 and 20. A live orchestra drifts a little in tempo, so the seats are not evenly spaced: each boundary sits on a beat picked from the song. Main shape: 0-8.7 the quiet theme / 8.7 loud / 46 the quiet second theme / 58, 62.5 loud / 76-102 soft / 102.3 loud / (the join) / 140.33- the last chord
source_note: The video is clips made with AI (Gemini), put on the song. The intro picture is the top of the first picture's background. The finished video has the title burned into the close (seat 27), so that seat uses the picture without a title, videos/key_26.png, and final_still draws the title on it. clip_start_sec is the frame where the seat really starts in the finished video (0-3 frames after at: the frames were rounded when it was made, and the rounding adds up). Cut at at, a seat would open on the last frames of the seat before

final_still.title: Six Friends Smoothie
final_still.note: The top of the closing picture is a light cream, so the title is dark brown

page.title: Six Friends Smoothie
page.lead: The Marriage of Figaro overture and the six friends: an empty blender, the friends coming in one at a time and dancing, and at the end a swirl of light that turns them into a smoothie. 2 min 29 s, no voice. Point at the seats you want to change and put your own photos or videos in them.

beat_notes.0 Intro (the quiet theme): Nobody yet: the morning kitchen and an empty blender.
beat_notes.I Entrances (the loud theme, one friend: One friend about every 5 seconds, in the order of the second picture.
beat_notes.III Big party (the climax, the join, the: The song is joined between seats 19 and 20 (the cut hides the join). A big party in a ring.
beat_notes.IV Transformation (the top of the coda): No blades: light, a swirl and sparkles make them "become one".
beat_notes.V Close (the last chord): The full blender and the title.
